explication: Flink CDC is a distributed Flink-based system for real-time and batch change-data capture, synchronization, and transformation. The principal pipeline workflow is to submit a YAML definition, parse source/sink and optional routing and transformation settings, compose a Flink execution, and run it against connectors. The README also documents SQL and DataStream APIs. The sampled sources show definition parsing and Flink composition; connector internals and several runtime subsystems were not sampled, so their implementation-level links are not asserted.
